thread:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate detected on model-serving-prod. 5xx spike from runtime nodes. Paging eng-oncall. Service: /v1/generate, error rate 18% in last 5m. traces.redwood.example/r=abc123

sam: i'm on it. seeing a bunch of kernel resets in the node logs (GPU watchdog). starting live triage.

mia: @sam any customer  impact yet? which tenants?

sam: initial look — errors correlated with calls to multistream-runner-2 and model-runner-quant. Top affected customers: acme, quickchat (high QPS). latency also up to 2.1s for some requests.

nate: attaching log snippet from model-runner-quant pod: ```kernel: NVRM: GPU reset detected - reason: GSP watchDogTimeout
[...]
Segmentation fault (core dumped) at inference loop
```

anya: that matches a deploy we rolled out 40m ago (quantized kernels v2.1.4). rolling back might stop the segfaults.

lee: i'm spinning up additional fallback pool with non-quantized model v2.0.3. routing policy to fallback for requests over 1.5s.

ops-oncall: setting temporary rate-limit for /v1/generate to reduce tail pressure: 200rps global. i'll also disable batching for the quantized runner to see if memory spikes stop.

sam: kubectl to one of the crashed pods shows OOM on process inference_engine (rss peaked at 28GB then crash). suspect memory regression in recent quant kernels.

mia: customer impact: acme showing 22% failed requests over last 10m, alerts from their SRE. opened ticket INC-5741 and notified account team. quickchat paused some jobs.

nate: trying a quick repro with a reduced prompt to isolate: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/prod/v1/generate -d '{"model":"quant-v2","prompt":"<long chat>"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."``` got immediate 5xx and worker crashed.

anya: i'm starting a rollback to quant v2.0.3 on a canary set (10% of traffic) and will escalate to full roll-forward to stable if green.

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy rollback started by anya — canary -> 10% traffic. Monitoring routing and error-rate dashboards.

lee: also cordoning nodes with GPU driver 515.x — those show highest reset counts. `kubectl drain node/gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

sam: good call. i'm dumping KV cache metrics to check if cache corruption contributed. so far KV hit rate fine.

ops-oncall: temporary mitigation checklist applied: reduced max_batch_tokens, disabled continuous batching on quant group, enabled fallback routing to non-quant pool.

mia: can we notify customers on status page? i'll draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors on model-serving due to GPU resets affecting quantized runners. Mitigation in progress: rolling back recent quant kernel update and routing traffc to fallback. Some customers may see degraded throughput."

nate: after canary rollback we saw 90% reduction in crashes on those pods within 3m. pushing full rollback now.

anya: full rollback complete at +18m from page. error rate dropped from 18% -> 2.3% in 10m window.

sam: collecting core dumps and opened bug RED-2319 for kernel interaction with quant kernels. attaching minimal repro and upload location: gs://redwood-incident-dumps/3492104321/

lee: patch plan: revert quant-kernel changes, add extra memory guards, and add watchdog backoff in runtime loop. patch PR ready: https://git.internal/redwood/quant-kernel/pull/425

ops-oncall: customer impact summary: acme & quickchat experienced intermittent 5xx and elevated latency for ~24m window. SLAs impacted but majority of requests served via fallback. ops has sent initial incident notification to accounts.

mia: team note: why did watchdog resets cascade into segfaults? seems the recovery path attempted to use freed GPU memory. need a postmortem.

sam: handoff: i'll be on-call for next 40m to ensure no regression and follow up on core analysis. @eng-oncall-bot please assign follow-up to nate and anya for patch rollout and longer-term mitigation.

eng-oncall-bot: Follow-up tasks assigned: RED-2319 (analysis) -> nate, RED-2320 (patch/rollback validation) -> anya. ETA 48h.

anya: adding temp alerting rule to detect GPU reset spikes: trigger if node reset_count > 5 in 5m.

nate: adding more granular tracing to capture per-request GPU memory usage next deploy.

mia: final comms: status page updated, customer emails queued for impacted accounts, account team aware.

ops-oncall: closing incident bridge in 30m unless new regressions. any objections? :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: no objections.

lee: :+1:

anya: handing off to night oncall. leaving runbook notes in the incident ticket.

sam: thanks everyone. root cause suspected: GPU watchdog resets triggered by quant kernel regression causing memory corruption and segfaults; rollback mitigated. full postmortem + remediation plan being tracked in RED-2319.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident bridge closed by eng-oncall-bot at 3492104800.
